findings.smallest_fix: Move the pristine backup copy after the guard and suite containment/symlink checks, before running any probes.

findings.failure_path: The packet omits the guard, fixture builder, assertion helpers, cleanup implementation, and repository/agent-contract gate wiring. findings.smallest_fix: Widen the frozen review context with those unchanged implementations and candidate-bound gate evidence, including the missing-contract negative case. No duplicated implementation or cosmetic candidate edit is needed.
